content:
Naked Creek was settled by members of the Blue Ridge Caravan Company lead by Marley on orders from Joanna Mayfield to re-establish the company's southern trade routes in Shenandoah. Over the next several days the group was attacked by a "big dog thing" which killed the members of the expedition.[1][2][3] The location has since become a nest for Thrashers.

↑"We've been sent back down to Shenandoah to try and re-establish our old trade routes. Joanna said she'll be in touch soon, but she's got her little protege Marley running the show, so I guess we're stuck with her as our contact. Others seem to think she's all right, but she seems pretty cold to me. Anyway, we got no choice if we want to get paid. To greener pastures I guess." (Southern Route)

↑"Something's picking us off. Judy and Joel disappeared in the night and one of the Brahmin was gutted. Maybe more like "shredded". Dennis panicked and made a break for it but we found him not far, dead on the road. We've buried him on the little island next to the river. This place is too dangerous, we're going to pack up tonight and head back north." (Getting Worse)

↑"Anyone who finds this. Some kind of big dog thing. It mauled everyone. All dead. Still around. Get out. I hate you Vinny!" (All Dead)
